protocol.task: one next full calendar minute; no recursive generation
protocol.reference: VWAP of latest nonempty complete received-second in 60-second input window; float32 archived additive amounts; NOT exact last trade or midpoint
protocol.reference_quality: exclude windows without observed executions or with reference older than 2 seconds at cutoff; never fall back to stale candle close
protocol.secondary: candle colour close vs own open; neutral exact equality; separate probabilities
protocol.inputs: 1440 candles, 60 book/trade seconds, observed reference displacement from last completed close
protocol.split: fit Oct1-18; development Oct19-21; calibration Oct22-23; shared inspected benchmark Oct24-31, 2026 UTC
protocol.selection: lowest mean three-seed primary development log loss; inference seed17 fixed; early stopping per seed on primary development log loss
protocol.loss: unweighted primary cross entropy + 0.25 secondary colour cross entropy
protocol.calibration: per-head scalar temperature, calibration log loss minimized on fixed 161-point log grid [.1,10]
limitations: Historical candle availability assumed; provider receipt clocks unverified.
October benchmark previously inspected; fresh confirmation required.
No trade win-rate, profitability, news, hidden orders or live accuracy claim.
Three outcomes do not identify a continuous price density or candle-path heatmap.
